notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing that much damage to an opponent.
Virtue of Courage triggers, causing you to exile that many cards from the top of your library.
Laelia's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.
